name: Princess
source:
Age: 16, 17
Race: Female human
Origin: Zeiva Kingdom
Job: Princess

Princess of Zeiva Kingdom is the main character in Other Age. As the silent protagonist, her personality is determined by the player. She is also the inheritor of teh Mirage Bloodline, which can be seen as a blessing or a curse. It seems that she has managed to date on her 16th birthday.
